entities.title: Neon Cycles
entities.summary: A modern light-cycle arena game in Godot 4 for the browser: the player and three computer riders leave glowing walls behind them, and the last rider left wins the round; the first to five rounds wins the match.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/, the page around the web export in web/, the Worker that serves it behind the sign-in in worker/, and the Worker's tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
The game keeps nothing between visits: no scores, no progress, no database. It loads nothing from outside this origin.
The web export uses Godot's Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2) and no threads, so the page needs no cross-origin isolation headers.
